task_name: Anvil and Oak - Gym opening member collateral
client_brief:
Athlete cards and spotlight portraits for our gym opening

Anvil and Oak needs opening-roster cards and a consistent portrait set. Sixteen members were photographed across three evenings, and the colour differences are obvious when the portraits sit on our dark ground.

What we need back
- Opening-roster athlete card: 17 named exports. The portrait belongs to the named athlete. The squat, bench and deadlift figures match this athlete record.
- Opening gym spotlight: 3 named exports. The gym identity is visible. The opening message follows approved copy.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: An independent strength and functional training studio selling coached memberships and drop in sessions.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Providence, Rhode Island; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: Anvil and Oak is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Providence, Rhode Island, and this commission covers phase 1: studio opening identity and member cards.
brand_identity.audience: People aged 25 to 45 choosing coached strength work over a commodity gym, here to get strong, who value programming detail and competence over amenities.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Memberships run 110 to 185 dollars a month with a 28 dollar drop in. Roughly double a chain gym, priced on coaching. Confident and specific, neither a soft boutique wellness studio nor a discount chain.
brand_identity.typography: Right Grotesk Compact Black sets the wordmark, athlete names and spotlight headlines. The signature is a justified cap stack: lines are sized so all measure the identical width, a solid rectangle of condensed caps in Bone reversed out of Anvil Black, closed by a 2 pt Brass rule tight under the last line. A viewer registers that black brick first. Atlas Grotesk Regular sets body 9.5 pt on 13 pt, Medium tabular carries lift figures at 28 pt; names 34 pt, headlines 104 px, field labels 7.5 pt caps tracked 120 units. Never track the display face positive.
brand_identity.voice: Direct, plain and sure of itself, the way a good coach cues a lift. No hype, no percentages shouted. Example line the brand would write: Show up, do the work, add weight. We handle the programming so you can focus on the bar.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: There is no logo file. The mark, an anvil silhouette inside a ring of lettering with an oak sprig crossing the anvil's horn, exists only as the sign painter's hand painted work on the studio's brick wall, which the coaches have photographed. Athlete portraits were shot by the coaches over three evenings and are not consistent. The old printer's press file is all that survives of the athlete card.
brand_identity.values: One mark, everywhere, complete and on the dark ground. The identity is the recovered wall mark used consistently, and the studio should always read as coached strength at its true price.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: Every name and headline is a justified stack of Right Grotesk Compact Black caps, all lines sized to the identical width so the type forms one solid rectangle, closed by a 2 pt Brass rule locked tight under the last line.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Reconcile records before merge and prove page, row, name, and amount completeness from the delivered artifacts.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
